overview_heading: Change in the size of the federal public service
overview_description: This section provides an overview of recent changes in the size of the federal public service, including a breakdown by job tenure as well as details on departments with the largest variations over the reference period.
composition_heading: Size of the federal public service, by job tenure
composition_description: This chart displays the total number of positions and full-time equivalents (FTEs) in the federal public service broken down by job tenure, from 2015-16 to the latest quarter available.
comparison_heading: Comparison of staffing trends within the federal public service by department
comparison_description: This chart allows a comparison of trends in headcount and full-time equivalents (FTEs) between selected departments. Please select departments below to compare staffing trends. Users may also select the displayed timeframe as well as specific job tenures for additional insights.
